title: Story with duplicated acceptance criteria
measures: duplicates kept as separate ACs (no merge)

story.summary: Shopper sees stock availability on the product page
story.description:
As a shopper I want to see whether a product is available before adding it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The product page shows "In stock" when at least one unit is available.
- The product page shows "Out of stock" when no units are available.
- The product page shows "In stock" when at least one unit is available.
- The "Add to cart" button is disabled when the product is out of stock.
